searchText: EIPIP meeting 32 Agenda - https://github.com/ethereum-cat-herders/EIPIP/issues/67 Need other editors to chime in on https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2228, specifically whether we want the can of worms that is trademarking in EIPs or not. In previous reviews I asked the author to remove the Trademark section to avoid that can of worms but they are pretty set on getting it added. I still advocate against including legal stuff beyond the CC0 copyright in the EIPs repository, but as usual I'll defer to the EIP Editors group as a whole on this. <@!301186049323958275> I should think it's up to the Foundation itself to enforce their trademarks as they see fit. (meeting in 30 mins) Join Zoom Meeting https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82357016731?pwd=V0hLUWIvU2V2UTdUd216WHdGNFBKUT09 Meeting ID: 823 5701 6731 Passcode: 885372 have a meeting conflict, probably will be 30 minutes late <@!396163506757435403> are you planning to join? <@!301186049323958275> this is what you mentioned on the call this AM, right? https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2228#trademark-note Given that the EIP is already merged, do you still think it's worth asking for an EF opinion on it? If so, should the reply go to the `discussions-to` link?
